environment.source: owner-reported setup; verifier requires one baseline display and Stage Manager

provenance.promptVariant: local copy with Chinese owner prompts
provenance.returnStimulus: fixture-only move-to-main-display command file; fixture moves its own window outside OpenCU, not a person dragging it

checks.name: start: visible preview, one display, no admitted windows, foreground/pointer unchanged
consent: decline reduced; two exact windows require separate approvals
Stage Manager: indexed/coordinate/CJK/shortcut/menu effects; foreground/pointer unchanged
manual return: input revoked and cleanup leaves the window there
tool stop: exact restoration, apps open, fresh removal, idempotence
idle host close: later calls observe permanent person stop; cleanup confirmed
EOF: pending consent and idle leave no host, stream, display or worker

limits: Owner-run acceptance before rebase; no post-rebase 0.4.1 GUI run is claimed.
Window return was simulated by the disposable fixture itself; it does not prove use of a real application Window menu.
Foreground/pointer sampling can miss transitions shorter than the measured sampling interval.
External monitors, other display layouts, other applications and macOS versions are not established by this run.
separateOwnerObservations: In earlier runs, the first capture from a new build path showed the macOS capture reminder once; it named opencu. This is owner-reported and is not a check in this pass report.
